proposals.name: Lumber Maton
proposals.entry:
The Lumber Maton is a cheap military construct manufactured by Drusha engineer-warlocks for their Gravosk allies.

Its body is intentionally crude. Arms and legs are cut from basic structural timbers. Factory-made hinges form the knees, elbows and shoulders. Thick sheet metal is nailed or bolted across the chest. The head is carved roughly from a block of wood to resemble a terrifying Gravosk face, complete with horns.

Most carry no conventional weapon. Their elongated arms terminate in heavy built-in axe blades. A cheap engine assembly is bolted directly onto the back. Its fuel is a strange magenta substance related somehow to concentrated Thunder-Mead. Exhaust leaves magenta smoke, greasy soot and a faint violet glow within the Maton’s eye sockets.

Lumber Matons are not elegant or particularly clever. They are extremely easy to repair. A shattered limb can be removed at the factory joint, replaced with another timber and returned to service.

The Drusha manufacture the specialized mechanisms. The Gravosk supply the wood. Gravosk longboats therefore sail into Drusha ports loaded with selected northern lumber and return carrying Matons.

posts.name: Gamemaster Only
posts.entry:
Some veteran Lumber Matons begin refusing replacement limbs unless the new timber comes from particular forests. The Drusha insist this is mechanically impossible.

One Lumber Maton has returned from three battles after being officially destroyed in each one. Nobody is certain how much of the original construct remains.
